Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported strong financial performance in Q1 FY27 with revenue growth of 27% and EBITDA growth of 55% year-on-year, driven by healthy operating leverage, disciplined cost management, and robust construction equipment demand. Management highlighted that the company's net cash position stands at approximately INR190 crores and noted that the Mexico warehouse operations are on track with first customer deliveries expected in Q3 FY27. Furthermore, the company expects FY27 growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than FY26 on a year-on-year basis, while maintaining a cycle EBITDA margin target of around 20%. Uniparts India reported a strong Q1 FY27 performance with revenue up 27% year-on-year, EBITDA up 55%, and PAT up 64%, driven by operational execution and meeting quarterly guidance. Management highlighted that the restoration of the Ludhiana finishing shop is progressing on schedule and Mexico warehouse customer deliveries remain on track for Q3.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 revenue growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company's Q1 FY27 performance was in line with the quarter-on-quarter guidance shared earlier and better than the annual guidance given.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The small agriculture segment in North America is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction segment momentum under technology and government-led infrastructure investments continues to sustain healthy customer schedules and order visibility.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural equipment conditions remain subdued, with leading OEMs indicating 2026 represents the cyclical bottom.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the large agricultural equipment, conditions remain subdued as has been widely acknowledged across the industry. Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agricultural equipment in India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket business represented approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Large ag industry is expected to face mid-teens decline in the current year.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the US and Europe is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: India continues to perform well in small agriculture, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption in mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: In Western markets, small ag growth remains more measured as economic uncertainty and volatility have tempered consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: In Western markets, small ag growth remains more measured. Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

demand_outlook.claim: In large agriculture, leading OEMs indicate that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing in the aftermarket segment, but normalcy is expected as tariffs have come down.
demand_outlook.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing. With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalise and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment in North America.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.

demand_outlook.claim: The European small agriculture market is showing early signs of stabilization after a prolonged period of softening.
demand_outlook.quote: In Europe, the small agriculture market is showing early signs of stabilization after a prolonged period of softening.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural machinery continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.
demand_outlook.quote: Let me talk about the large agricultural machinery, continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket continues to be a stable contributor for Uniparts across North America and Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: We also have the aftermarket sector, and the aftermarket continues to be a stable contributor for Uniparts across North America and Europe.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering a 55% growth year-on-year and 10% sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials for the quarter was about 33.3%, driven by a product mix change.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: Cycle EBITDA margins are maintained at about 20% over a peak to trough cycle.
margins_costs.quote: So Mr. Jain, when we talk about 20% margins, we are talking about 20% margins over a cycle which is peak to trough. We maintain that.

margins_costs.claim: Material cost is typically expected to be in the range of 34% to 37%.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% for quarter 4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management has stated consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash generated during the quarter was INR44 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: Organic capital expenditure requirements for the business are roughly about 2.5% to 3.5% of total revenue.
capital_allocation.quote: today, our capex requirements as a business are roughly about 2.5% to 3.5% of our total revenue.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, rebuilt to the level seen before a special dividend of INR 101 crore was declared in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation. To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore. In ten months, through focussed operations and business growth, we have rebuilt to that level.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate its strategic agenda.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases in Western small ag markets has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Towards the end of quarter 3, one of the facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the fabrication vertical to become a meaningful vertical in the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the warehouse in Mexico are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Normal operations from the Ludhiana facility are expected to return on schedule as rebuilding is underway.
management_commitments.quote: We expect normal operations to return on schedule.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to operate comfortably above the 20% EBITDA level as volumes build through FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
